+++ b/pkg/files/reader.go
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+package files
+
+import (
+	"io"
+	"os"
+)
+
+func ReadAll(paths []string) [][]byte {
+	var results [][]byte
+	for _, path := range paths {
+		f, err := os.Open(path)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		defer f.Close()
+		data, _ := io.ReadAll(f)
+		results = append(results, data)
+	}
+	return results
+}

human_labels.body: Expected: Defer inside loop causes resource leak
